name: Ruri no Ie -Domination Game-
original_name: 瑠璃の檻 ルリ・ノ・イエ －DOMINATION GAME－
source: Events take place on an island that mirrors Innsmouth in the mythos.  It is ruled by the Mashuu Family, and the hero ends up marrying the last daughter of that family, Mizuki.  He also gets stuck with an immense power and the role of giving women over to the islanders as breeders.
translation: 故事发生在一座仿照神话中印斯茅斯的岛屿上。岛屿由摩州家族统治，主人公最终娶了该家族最小的女儿水树。他还被赋予了强大得惊人的力量，以及把女性交给岛民作为繁殖对象的职责。
